content: Research indicates that diabetes self-management education and support (DSMES) significantly enhances patients' understanding of diabetes and their ability to manage the condition effectively. It leads to improved self-care behaviors, such as adherence to medication, dietary adjustments, and regular physical activity. Additionally, DSMES contributes to a better quality of life by addressing psychosocial aspects, such as reducing anxiety levels and fostering improved coping mechanisms for dealing with the challenges of diabetes. Furthermore, DSMES has been shown to facilitate better glycemic control. For instance, the use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) as part of DSMES has been associated with improved hemoglobin A1C levels, reflecting better long-term blood glucose management.
